items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: Eli Oberstein came through town with the portable unit and we recorded in some loft up there and we made six sides there

ctx.x: You broadcast from there, didn't you?

Yes. We had a lot of air time. That was the whole idea. Sitting there with no money, was to get the air time. We were recording. We had made some records prior to that. We made some records in New Orleans for Bluebird. Eli Oberstein came through town with the portable unit and we recorded in some loft up there and we made six sides there, six or eight, I forget how many. Not any more than eight.
I think they're in here, right?
